scope: Randomized variants of every Paladin, Druid and Warrior tank request of the accepted fixtures, against 3 and 5 copies of the boss that all swing at the tank: the shields, absorbs, item procs, cooldowns, Sulfuras, Eye for an Eye, Retaliation, Blood Craze and Goblin Sapper variants of the Protection, Holy Protection, Ret Protection and Fury Protection builds and the bear. 3 for each of 134 bases at 200 iterations, each exported with the pinned Go engine and run by Go and Rust. The sweep sets every copy of the boss to the variant's level, so the targets stay identical, and draws each variant's race from Human, Dwarf and Undead for the Paladins, Night Elf and Tauren for the Druids and Human, Dwarf, Orc and Undead for the Warriors.
generator: python3 tools/copy_targets.py --counts 3,5 --tanks-only --output <scratch>/bases fixtures/mage/prepared-v2/*.request.json, then for each Paladin, Druid and Warrior base python3 tools/sweep.py BASE --seed 20261009 --count 3 --iterations 200 --max-distance 5 --races RACES --output <scratch>/variants/NAME, with RACES as the scope says; each variant <scratch>/variants/NAME/sweep-XX.json is compared as NAME-sweep-XX.request.json
rerun: python3 tools/prepared_v2.py compare --output <scratch> <variants>/*/*.request.json, with the variants named as the generator says

criteria.comparison: full RaidSimResult except elapsedNs, lists keyed by ID
criteria.deviations: as variances at the scale of mean^2

notes: Every variant matches the pinned Go engine on the whole result and the first-fight log.
The Rogue and Mage tank requests of the fixtures are not swept: the gate refuses a tank of a class that has not been checked against every copy swinging at it, as the fixture record shows.
